title: Update landing page footer contact details

requirements.summary: Replace footer placeholder address and phone number on the landing page with the provided real contact details while keeping layout/theme unchanged.
acceptanceCriteria: In frontend/src/App.tsx footer section, the text "[Your Address Here]" is replaced with: "Shop No. 7, Rajeev Gandhi Complex, Manisha Market, Shahpura Lake, Shahpura, Bhopal, Madhya Pradesh 462039".
In frontend/src/App.tsx footer section, the text "Phone: [Your Phone Number]" is replaced with: "Phone: 09981123849".
No other landing page sections (navbar, hero, featured collection, why-choose-us) are changed.
Footer layout and styling remain consistent with the existing golden/cream theme and responsive behavior.

file_operations.description: In the existing footer JSX, replace the two placeholder strings ([Your Address Here] and Phone: [Your Phone Number]) with the exact provided address and phone number, without altering any other sections or footer structure/styling.
